# HigherBits.dev

> HigherBits.dev is a marketplace of production-ready shadcn/ui components,
> templates, and UI blocks for developers, agencies, and technical virtual
> assistants.

Components are copy-paste React and Tailwind CSS, built on shadcn/ui and Radix UI
primitives. Creators publish and monetise components; buyers install them by
pasting source into their own projects, with no runtime dependency on
HigherBits.dev. Each component states its own licence on its detail page; the
default is MIT.
